newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia's net foreign reserves dip $21.2 mln.
newsitem.headline: Colombia's net foreign reserves dip $21.2 mln.

text.p: Colombia's net international reserves stood at $10.28 billion as of July 18, the last date for which official figures are available, the central bank said Monday.
The figure was $21.2 million lower than July 11 and was pushed down by a $218.3 million fall in gross reserves coupled with a $197 million drop in short term foreign debt.
According to the central bank accumulated net reserves have grown $388.4 million this year, a 3.9 percent increase over last year.
Gross reserves stood at $10.4 billion as of July 18.
